block_1_meta_context.design_objective: Tạo giao diện gọi xe 3-chạm tối giản, định vị trực quan trên bản đồ vector, hiển thị cước phí cố định minh bạch giữa các địa điểm đón trả thực tế tại địa phương.
block_1_meta_context.simplicity_principle: Không cài thêm app cồng kềnh, hoạt động mượt mà trên nền tảng PWA di động, nút bấm to rõ cho cả người lớn tuổi.

block_6_midjourney_v6_prompt.prompt_raw: A hyper-detailed, award-winning mobile UI/UX design of a modern ride-hailing app for local districts in Vietnam, presented on an iPhone 16 Pro mockup. Top status bar shows: 'TT. Phước An, Krông Pắk, Đắk Lắk' with clear GPS location pin. The upper half features a clean interactive vector map with street networks, rivers, and accurate pins displaying nearby 7-seater cars and scooters. Route polyline drawn in emerald green connecting Phước An to Buôn Ma Thuột. The lower half features a dark obsidian bottom sheet with glassmorphism texture containing: 1. Location inputs: Origin 'Chợ TT. Phước An' with green dot, Destination 'Ngã 6 Buôn Ma Thuột' with red dot. 2. Three vehicle selector cards: Card 1 highlighted in bold green 'Xe Ghép Tiện Chuyến - 35.000đ/ghế', Card 2 'Bao Xe Gia Đình 4-7 Chỗ - 180.000đ', Card 3 'Xe Ôm / Ship Đón Nhanh - 30.000đ'. 3. A large pill button in vibrant Grab green #00B14F: 'ĐẶT XE NGAY'. Ultra high resolution 8k, Figma design showcase on Dribbble and Behance, soft studio lighting, crisp Vietnamese typography, zero artifacts --ar 9:16 --v 6.0

block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.dalle_3: Sleek mobile app interface for a Vietnamese rural-district ride hailing app called Đắk Lắk Express on an iPhone. The screen has a vector map on top with a route polyline between Phước An market and Buôn Ma Thuột city center with vehicle pins. Bottom half has dark mode cards with options for carpooling (Xe ghép 35.000đ), private car (Bao xe 180.000đ), and scooter (Xe ôm 30.000đ). Primary button is vivid emerald green with text 'Đặt Xe Ngay'. Clean typography, modern UI design, Behance trending.
block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.flux_sdxl: masterpiece, best quality, mobile UI design, ride-hailing app, dark obsidian background #090D16, emerald green accents #00B14F, Leaflet vector map with route polyline, local Vietnamese landmarks, transport pricing cards, iPhone 16 Pro mockup, sharp focus, clean UI elements, modern graphic design, 8k resolution
block_7_dalle3_flux_sdxl_prompts.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, pixelated, ugly fonts, broken map tiles, cropped buttons, messy layout, durian fruit, agriculture crops, 3d cartoon characters, unreadable text
